title: People love saying this:
paragraphs: But have you ever read what God actually says about the human heart?

“The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?”
— Jeremiah 17:9 (KJV)

The heart we trust…
is the very thing Scripture warns us about.

Your heart can justify sin.
Your heart can make wrong feel right.
Your heart can convince you that you’re fine with God when you’re actually far from Him.
That’s why the Bible never says “follow your heart.”

Trust in the Lord.
Repent and turn to God.
Let Him give you a new heart.

The gospel isn’t about trusting your feelings.
It’s about being transformed by Christ.
God knowing your heart isn’t comforting if your heart is still ruled by sin.
That’s why Jesus didn’t come just to understand your heart.

Has God changed your heart…
or are you still trusting it?

Agree or disagree?
Do people use “God knows my heart” as an excuse sometimes? 👇
